professionalSummary.text: Owns the vendor portfolio for the support product, negotiating renewals and signing off contract values within delegated limits.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintains the vendor contract register and the renewal calendar.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Runs quarterly vendor reviews with the service owners and records the outcomes.

skills.text: Coordinates vendor changes with finance and security and records own responsibility boundaries.
skills.witness: Updated the vendor risk register each quarter from the security team's assessments and the service owners' incident notes, and wrote the quarter-end note on open risks and hand, over items.
